Blast it! Every time I try to calibrate these sensitive arcane instruments, they get thrown off again by a surge of energy.
The surges seem to be coming from the north, where those primitive Kobolds have been practicing their crude magic. Could you clear some of them out, so I can continue my work?

objectives.text: Kill 8 Kobold Geomancers in Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hamish Bergwort in the Tower of Azora.

accept.text: Good steel is in short supply after the war, and our tools have suffered for it. The Jasperlode miners used finely-crafted picks, and I imagine some of them are still there in the depths of the mine. Could you retrieve some for me, and I'll see if I can repurpose the steel?

objectives.text: Collect 4 Mining Tools from Jasperlode Mine, then return to Hagar Lowe in Eastvale Logging Camp.

accept.text:
I was bringing back a supply shipment from the trading post, but my wagon tipped over and the supplies fell in the river! Before I could catch them, they had already washed downstream.

Between the murlocs and wolves down there, I don't stand a chance of retrieving the supplies on my own. You seem like the hardy sort. Do you think you could find them for me?

objectives.text: Collect the Waterlogged Axe, Waterlogged Saw, and Waterlogged Toolbox that have washed downstream from Eastvale Logging Camp, then return to Ormin Pelford.

accept.text:
<One of the kobolds dropped this book. It looks like the kobold might have tried to eat it.

Brother Paxton inside the abbey has a small library he maintains. The book must have come from there.>

complete.text:
Hey! How did you end up with that? It's supposed to be on the shelf! Oh dear, the kobolds have been stealing my books again. They must want to eat them!

Thanks for bringing back the book, but what will I do about the rest of my missing collection?

objectives.text: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

progress.text: What's that you got there? It looks like one of my books.

accept.text: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.

complete.text:
Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.

But there are still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?

objectives.text: Retrieve $1oa Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.

progress.text: Have you rescued my books yet, $N?!

accept.text: Go talk to the new mining apprentice, Kelsey Fargo. She works right outside the mine and has probably seen what the kobolds are up to. Maybe she can teach you a thing or two about mining while you're at it.

complete.text: Kobolds with books? Yah, I've seen kobolds running back and forth with books, yelling at each other. They must be stealing them from the library inside the abbey.

objectives.text: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

accept.text:
Every once in a while, a kobold comes through yelling "Picture for Narf!" I don't know who Narf is. Maybe one of the head kobolds at the back of the mine? I bet he has a whole sack of books by now.

Go get those books and bring them to our local law enforcement, Marshal McBride. You should find a friend to help. Those kobolds inside the mine are a lot meaner.

complete.text:
Thank you for returning these stolen books, $N. I'll get them back to Brother Paxton at once.

You're becoming quite the hero around here. Great job!

objectives.text: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf. Bring the sack to Marshal McBride just inside Northshire's Abbey.

progress.text: Have you retrieved those stolen books yet?

accept.text:
You're not done with those kobolds yet. We just got word from Kelsey that a kobold left the mine carrying a large sack of books. I need you to track down this kobold so we can retrieve the books for Brother Paxton.

Go talk to Tordrin Sternblade. He's the new $C trainer that just arrived from Ironforge. You can find him behind the abbey, near the stable. He can help you track this kobold thief.

complete.text: I can help ye' track down this varmint. Let me whip somethin' up for ye'.

objectives.text: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

accept.text:
Alright. Take this kobold tracking kit. It'll let ye' track the kobold that Marshal McBride is concerned with.

Follow the tracks and bring what ye' find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.

I have a feelin' these varmints are up to somethin' outside Northshire. So ye'll be needin' Dughan's help.

complete.text:
What's this, $N? Tracking kobolds?

Well, of course they're headed toward the Fargodeep mine! That place is infested with kobolds.

Good work, I guess. I'm going to need someone to take care of that problem.

objectives.text: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.

progress.text: Have you figured out where the Kobolds are heading?

accept.text:
While you're investigating the Fargodeep Mine, see if you can find any of Brother Paxton's books to return. In particular, Paxton is very concerned about a book titled, "Fun with Elementals". He thinks even a kobold could use it to summon an elemental servant. Be warned, the depths of the mine are fairly dangerous. You should bring friends.

Take this book bag to protect the books when you find them!

complete.text:
I applaud your diligence, $N. Brother Paxton sent a list of books, and you've found most of the missing ones. The rest must have been taken to the Jasperlode Mine.

You can keep that book bag!

objectives.text: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.

progress.text: Have you found all the books yet?

accept.text:
There are just two books left missing on Brother Paxton's list: "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words".

The kobolds must have taken them to the Jasperlode Mine. Please track down those two books and bring them back to Brother Paxton.

But I'm afraid it will be quite dangerous. If the "apprentice" kobold was summoning an elemental, who knows what the master can do. I'd bring some friends if I were you.

objectives.text: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.

accept.text:
We need to take stock of how many books are missing!

Go talk to my useless assistant, Daniel. He can do a quick inventory and let us know how serious the problem is.

He's obsessed with the various trade professions in Elwynn Forest. The boy keeps focusing on those instead of his important work helping me.

Don't let him prattle on about tradeskills, and find out what's happened to my books!

complete.text:
Yah, I overheard. I warned Brother Paxton three times about the kobolds tunneling under the abbey.

It looks like the kobolds have taken a lot of books. There are whole bookshelves emptied out. You should probably see what Brother Paxton wants you to do about it.

While you're here, can I talk to you about tradeskills? I'd be happy to answer any questions you have, or point you toward the local trainers.

objectives.text: Speak to Daniel, Brother Paxton's assistant in the library.

accept.text: I was asked to bring this to your attention as soon as you returned from the kobold camps, $N. It appears to be a letter sealed with the mark of Tordrin Stemblade, our local $c trainer. Take a moment to read it before you go about any other business here in the Abbey.

complete.text:
Get yerself squared away, learn the lay o' the land, and come back to me whenever you need training. I'll be here night or day.

This land is grown' more dangerous, and as ye meet other folk, I think ye'll find they all have problems they could use some help with--help a skilled $c can give 'em. Good luck.

objectives.text: Read the Scribbled Letter and speak to Tordrin Stemblade in Northshire Abbey.

progress.text:
Ah, ye got me letter, $N... good.

Time was when ye'd not catch a $r dead wit' a bow in their hand--no more, I guess. It's good for Stormwind, but bad for the kobolds and man eatin' beasts in the area.

accept.text:
Apothecary Jorell was supposed to bring us a case of antidotes and elixirs days ago, but we're still empty handed. That fool has probably poisoned himself again by brewing in that poorly-ventilated shack he calls his lab.

If you want to further help our ward, you would be a far more reliable individual for this job.

Follow the road to Go'shek farm, south and a bit west of here. You'll likely find it packed and ready to go, with Jorell either missing or unconcerned with his obligations.

objectives.text: Pick up a case of Packaged Tonics at Jorell's lab in Go'shek Farm and return to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall.

complete.text:
My new home is surrounded by turtles, yet I have no knowledge of how to properly prepare their meat nor craft equipment with their scales.

As shameful as it feels, my survival has depended upon the aid of others outside my tribe. I have been humbled by the kindness of strangers, and humbled by the simple yet effective techniques they have taught me.

I hope to learn from this turtle scale breastplate in much the same way.

progress.text: <The $r woman acknowledges you with a glare, but allows you to approach nonetheless.>

accept.text:
Many hunters prefer to travel with animal companions. With a beast at your side, you will find that you can survive even the most dangerous of circumstances. As they say, everything is easier with a friend. However, obtaining an animal companion is something that must be done with care. The balance of nature is delicate, and must always be respected.

Take this Taming Rod with you to the forest. With it, you will be able to tame a Rockhide Boar and practice your skills as a $c.

objectives.text: Use the Taming Rod to tame a Rockhide Boar. Practice your skills, then return the Taming Rod to Josephine Carson.

accept.text:
If you be gettin' tired of dem wide open plains, my old friend Uzer'i always be lookin' for help. He always be twistin' dem magics, but little do most o' dem people know he be quite da hunter too.

If you's interested, you can find him all da way out at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

Tell him ol' Tan'jani sent ya.

objectives.text: Tan'jani wants you to speak with Witch Doctor Uzer'i at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

accept.text:
Before we fled Gnomeregan, I made a hard copy of my family's archives. Arcanotechnical field equations, Second War submarine hull designs, Grandma Quikswitch's chili recipe... our greatest accomplishments are in those files.

It wasn't until we reached Ironforge that I found a hole in my pack! Several punch cards are gone, and without them the data's too scrambled to recover.

The cards must be buried in the snow, somewhere outside Gnomeregan. Could you find them? I know it's a long shot...

objectives.text: Collect 7 Gnomeregan Archival Data cards from around Gnomeregan, then deliver them to Jemma Quikswitch in Ironforge.

complete.text:
Aggro'gosh sent you? I respect his willingness to support our efforts, though his concerns are his alone.

We will defeat the humans AND the Twilight's Hammer. If it's battle you seek, there are plenty of ways to engage your services in the name of the Horde.

accept.text:
I've been watching you, $n. You handle yourself well out here. Perhaps you'd be interested in helping me locate my brother, Tan'jani.

He was always searching for something--for what I do not know. I received two messages since he left. The first from another traveler, letting me know he'd run into Tan'jani somewhere south of Loch Modan. The second was a bloodstained letter mentioning Riverglades and somewhere called Rog'mar, even further south. The rest was illegible.

Think you can locate him for me?

complete.text:
Tor'gan sent ya all de way down here ta find me? He always be lookin' out for me. Hopin' I'll be seein' him sometime soon.

But I don't be leavin' my post till de job's done, yeah? Long history with Krom'rosh. Almost as long as Tor'gan. Almost.

Everything's fine here, mon. Nothin' ta worry bout. 'Cept for them Twilight always bein' up ta no good. Ol' Krom'rosh out by da big fire can tell ya more 'bout that.

objectives.text: Find Tan'jani at Rog'mar in the Riverglades.

accept.text:
This is odd. This piece of the tablet you have brought me refers to the lost city of I'lalai as if it is a massive sprawling civilization. But the ruins off of the reef are not large enough to be something of that size.

$n, to the north of the Vile Reef there is an ancient troll ruin on the hills along the coast. A tablet that contains legends of the lost troll city is within. I wish to study this legend further.

Take this hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of this tablet, then return to me.

complete.text: Excellent, this is exactly what I need. I have read this tablet before, but that was when I was a young $r. It's been many moons since then and my memory is not what it used to be.

objectives.text: Use the hide and charcoal to create a rubbing of the Third Troll Legend tablet.

progress.text:
Have you found the tablet?

I hope the Bloodscalp didn't give you too much trouble. If they did, I hope you killed them for it.

accept.text:
After rereading the legend, it doesn't seem like we are in the wrong place for the lost city, but perhaps there is yet some detail that has been overlooked.

In my younger years I used to dive in the Vile Reef ruins, but that was before the murlocs settled there. If memory serves there was a cavern there.

I have heard that there are now naga gathering in that region, which is unusual. I want to know what has lured them there.

Go and explore just west of the Vile Reef and return to me with any news.

objectives.text: Explore the Vile Reef and find the cavern entrance.

accept.text:
$C, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.

objectives.text: Gather $1oa Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.

accept.text:
Hey pal, you look like you can handle yourself in a fight.

Baron Revilgaz has me keep'n my ear to the ground for magical objects. Word on the street is that a sunken troll ruin has mysteriously become, eh, un-sunk, which means there are a lot of unclaimed goods, if you catch my meaning.

Problem is, it's also caught the eye of pirates! Not just any pirates, the Saltseers specifically collect magical artifacts. I need you to go into the Drowned City, clear them out and take their stolen artifacts.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Voodoo Infused Artifacts from Saltseer pirates in the Drowned City.

accept.text:
The Saltseer pirates have been a thorn in my side recently and knowing they're in the Drowned City makes it worse! I mean they're always bad news, but there is one captain in particular I want outta the picture. That damned Captain Dreadrise!

He and his crew are very accomplished at gathering all the magical artifacts I've been after, and I'm tired of the competition.

I want you to remove Captain Dreadrise and his Saltseer Coroners from the picture. Permanently.

objectives.text: Slay 3 Saltseer Coroners and Captain Dreadrise in the Drowned City.

accept.text:
'Ey boss-$Gmon:lady;, ya need help from ol' Tan'jani? Don't worry about it, I fix you up good.

Orcs be good at hittin' humans with axes, but when you wanna stick 'em before dey see ya comin', that's when you call on the headhunters. You wanna learn to stick 'em too? I see it in your eyes, heheh.

First we get you your own spears. Dis one's mine. Go to the human camp to de west and take their wood. Take knife with ya. You can sharpen their lumber into good spears for stickin'. Den bring 'em back.

objectives.text: Collect Wood Bundles from Peasant Woodpiles in Turner's Logging Camp then fletch them into $1oa Makeshift Stickin' Spears.

accept.text:
Well howdy there, $c. I can see you've got the look of an adventurer about you. Good for you. The world needs more of us restless souls, seeking fortune and glory.

It's a big wide world out there and you'll need to learn to thrive in the wilds to be successful. Not sure how your outdoorsman skills are but I reckon I could teach you a thing or two, if you'd be apt to learn.

Have a seat near the fire, get comfy. I'll walk you through it.

complete.text: So now that we've learned the basics, why don't you go and learn a tradeskill. They will also teach you the know-how to create a proper camp fixture suitable to your new profession.

objectives.text: Sit near Sam's Basic Campfire and wait until you receive the Boosted Rest buff.

accept.text:
So you want to learn more about camping, huh? Good for you, $c. The first step any adventurer needs to take is to become a cook and learn how to make a campfire.

Cooking's not just about making tasty foods. It's also the foundation for your camp.

objectives.text: Speak with Tomas in Goldshire to learn to become a cook.

accept.text:
$n, you have proven your competence as a protector thus far. That is why I am now entrusting you with an unusual task.

I've heard of a new adventurer down the road by Goldshire. Go and see what he's doing.

complete.text:
I appreciate the lookin' out, $c. That marshal's just a worrywart.

Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?

objectives.text: Speak to Sam Sarsparilla near Goldshire.

complete.text:
You say that all this fell off a zeppelin crash up at the northern side of the jungle, and Bloodscalp trolls had their hands on it? This was supposed to arrive at Powderfuse Port SIX WEEKS ago! We even struck a deal with Grom'gol to use their zeppelin tower for expedited shipping!

I wondered why Whizzbuzz has been sending me snarky letters. We should have never let Zimmix behind the wheel after what happened the last time.

Great. Just great. Take this and leave, I have insurance claims to file.

progress.text: You look confused. Lost?

accept.text:
You! Yes, you! Come here, keep your voice down!

I screwed up big time. I managed to secure a sweet deal for Booty Bay to use their zeppelin tower for expedited deliveries and on our very first route I saw a huge bird--err, got SHOT DOWN just to the east of here!

I survived the crash, unfortunately, but before I woke up, I was already being dragged by my ears! Now I'm surrounded by bloodthirsty trolls and locked in a cage!

Look, I just need the key, okay? I can escape on my own.

complete.text:
Is that the key?

<Zimmix lunges forward against the front of the cage and he repeatedly attempts to swipe the key from your possession.>

Just hand it over!

objectives.text: Bring the Primitive Key obtained from the trolls at the Ruins of Zul'kunda in Stranglethorn Vale to Zimmix Sputterspark.

progress.text:
Listen, I like you and all, but you standing around here is making us look suspicious! If you don't have the key then, I dunno, GO GET IT!

Please?

accept.text:
Wait, wait, don't go yet!

I know I said I just needed the key but... well, they caught me once, they could do it again, right? I'm just one goblin, and there's hundreds of trolls around here!

You've already put enough of a dent in their numbers to get this key, so it should be easy enough to stand guard while we mosey on out of here, huh?

complete.text:
Oh my gold. YOU were the one that rescued Zimmix?

Your timing could not have been worse. We just had a celebratory toast thinking he was finally out of our hair for good, and we have another critical delivery coming up that has yet to be assigned. Of course, he's already trying to claim it and, of course, I have to argue against it or we risk another one of his big blunders!

Word of advice: If you see a goblin trapped in a cage, they probably deserve it. Just leave them there next time.

objectives.text: Escort Zimmix Sputterspark away from the Ruins of Zul'Kunda then tell Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay of your successful rescue.

accept.text:
As much as I don't like the guy, I've heard what the Bloodscalp tribe do to their prisoners, and it ain't pretty. I'm glad Zimmix made it out alright.

However, I have another urgent delivery and I do NOT trust him to take it on. The problem? Nobody else will be available to take this before he does. You, however, have rescued lost cargo and a captured goblin, so you're looking pretty trustworthy from down here.

Any chance I can convince you to take this to Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port?

objectives.text: Deliver the Twice Reordered Package to Wharfmaster Whizzbuzz at Powderfuse Port in the Riverglades.

accept.text:
$n! Your arrival is timely, as always.

You have provided valuable assistance to the defense of Grom'gol, and we are grateful. After your recent push against the ogres nearby, we sent out a scout to see if there are more out there that may try to enact vengeance against us. As it turns out, there is a cave far to the east that they have claimed as their hovel.

Gather a friend or two and make it very clear that we will not tolerate another threat to our settlement, now or ever!

objectives.text: Commander Aggro'gosh of the Grom'gol base camp wants you to kill ogres at the Mosh'Ogg Ogre Mount.

accept.text:
Hi, can you help me?

My parents finally let me come along with them to this big jungle and they even let me pick a few plants just outside the gates. I'm trying to study herbalism so I can be an alchemist one day!

Anyway, I almost filled my backpack when a bunch of huge, angry weeds came out of nowhere and started spitting at me!

I ran away, and I'm fine, but now they won't let me play outside of the camp anymore. Can you make it safe for me, and then tell my mum?

complete.text:
Ah, I should have suspected that little Gemmy would try to persuade someone to help out with his situation.

Unfortunately, that was too close of a call when he was out last, and I don't even know what else might be lurking out there.

No, he will not be allowed to step another foot past those gates for another ten years or so. In fact, once his father is back from Booty Bay, he will be heading straight back to Durotar.

You don't have to deliver the news to him, I'll do that.

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Carnivorous Weeds south of Grom'gol and then inform Gemmil's mother.

accept.text:
This encampment is being left to rot. The siege damage stands, unrepaired, as if neglect were policy. I won't permit that same decay here. The infirmary answers to me, and I intend to keep it functional.

We are nearly out of supplies. I'm going to need more equipment--enough to keep the workers and guards on their feet.

Under pressure, we can make quite an effective field suture using twisted spider silk.

$C, bring me some from the spiders that stalk these highlands.

complete.text:
Splendid spider string. When you're being stitched back together, a little infection is the... least of your concerns.

Ahem, excuse me once again. Doctor humor.

Thanks for helping out the medical ward, $N. If only we could get this kind of help more regularly.

objectives.text: Return 12 Surgical Spidersilk to Doctor Gregory Victor in Hammerfall, Arathi Highlands.

progress.text:
The results are in, I've got good news and bad news for you.

Oh, excuse me.

accept.text:
I noticed a few rocks that seemed unusual in the Dustbowl. Upon closer inspection, I saw that they had carvings! I could not resist making rubbings of them to study later.

The nearby ogres took notice of my presence and before I could even react, I woke up under the care of the innkeeper, and with a terrible headache.

Now, I am down all of my supplies and without any study material while I heal. Can you venture to the east in search of my pack, and take rubbings of the etchings yourself?

objectives.text: Slay ogres in the Dustbowl for Mus'hale's Stolen Supplies and use them to collect rubbings of the nearby stone etchings, then return to Mus'hale at Kargath.

accept.text:
You look like a healthy, able-bodied $r. I am looking for someone to travel to Sunnyglade, in the Riverglades just north of the Redridge Mountains.

My family owned an armory there, once. Now I imagine it is a burnt husk, but I would have you retrieve a tome containing my family's ancestral armor crafting techniques. It was originally in the basement, so hopefully it has not succumbed to the elements just yet.

objectives.text: Travel to Sunnyglade in the Riverglades and recover the tome of Tremayne Family Blacksmithing Techniques.

accept.text:
Mining isn't the most glamorous, but it's good honest work and a fine profession for you to explore.

I reckon I know someone that can teach you how to craft a Lodestone for your camp. Build one of these and everyone who wants to swing a sword will be eager to gather round your fire and soak up the extra "oomph" it can provide to increase their combat prowess.

complete.text:
There you have it, you can now craft your very own Lodestone. Most folk don't care much for camps being set up in the center of town, so you'll need to head into the wilderness if you want to test it out.

Oh, and just remember, no camp is complete without a campfire. You'll need one of those before you start up your camp. Most cooks can teach you to make a fire. If you haven't already, you might want to check in with someone who can train you in the culinary arts to learn the basics.

objectives.text: Speak with Gelman Stonehand in Stormwind to learn to craft a camping item for your profession once you have shown proficiency in your skill.

complete.text:
Excellent! I can hardly contain my excitement. Oh, and the heart still has electrical pulses? That's impressive. I won't have to shock it back to life then!

This heart will be a wonderful addition to the abomination, and certainly looks to be the specified size, if these notes are correct.

Ah, I love it when a plan comes together.

progress.text: Oh, you've returned in one piece! Pity, if you hadn't your flesh and organs would have made excellent fodder for my tinkering.

accept.text:
Orcs, gnolls, murlocs. Everything seems to be out to stop me from getting this bridge done on time. Now we have word there's an infestation of tarantulas at our lumber mill!

If you're up to earn a bit more coin, would you head over to Alther's Mill to the east and clear out their spider problem? Place is as good as useless to me if I can't safely send workers to collect shipments.

Oh, and if you see ol' Alther, tell him he owes me for cleaning up his mess.

complete.text:
The mill is that bad? That's worse than I thought.

I'm not particularly squeamish, but work's bad enough without spiders snatching up my workers. Thanks for the help, $N!

objectives.text: Slay $1oa Greater Tarantulas and destroy $2oa Tarantula Eggs in Alther's Mill for Foreman Oslow in Redridge.

accept.text:
The fish just ain't biting today, and there's something wrong going on with them. It's not just empty hooks. I haven't seen a single minnow up in the water at all.

Lee here set up some traps overnight. Go check to see if we've at least got some stock there. If you find anything weird, make sure to show me.

complete.text: All the traps are like this? Seems our new neighboring nuisances are causing more destruction than we were aware of. I'll go broke if we don't do something about it.

objectives.text: Check the fishing traps in Crystal Lake.

progress.text: Any catches to speak of?

accept.text:
This can only be the work of those murlocs on the other side of the lake. They're disgusting little things, with a vicious temper and teeth to match. 

If we let this continue, there won't be any fish to speak of anywhere in this lake. If you could clear them out a bit, it would help me a ton.

complete.text: I can hear their warbling from here--it'll be in my nightmares. Well, that should slow them down--although I have no doubt that they'll make up those numbers quickly.

objectives.text: Kill $1oa Murlocs and $2oa Murloc Streamrunner at Crystal Lake, then return to Jason Mathers.

accept.text:
Remy mentioned murlocs the other day... I'm pretty sure he hates the little buggers as much as I do. 

He might have some ideas on how to keep them away from my fish in the future. I'd like to ask you to go chat with him and see if there's anything he can think of.

complete.text:
I've been warning the guards about the murlocs. They won't listen.

I have a few ideas on how to get back at those critters. I'll need your help getting what I need for it though.

objectives.text: Speak with Remy "Two Times" about Jason's murloc problems.

accept.text:
I've got a few ideas on how to deal with murlocs. And one of those also helps some others in the process.

There's a weed often found on farms in the area called duskweed, and in large quantities the petals are toxic to most animals. If we make some murloc bait with the plant, hopefully that can train those creatures to stay away.

And some farmers get their fields cleared in the process. Truly a win-win... truly a win-win.

complete.text:
Give me just a minute...

It's pretty simple bait, but as long as nobody's pet gets into it, it should be safe. Just tell Jason not to eat any of it.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa Vials of Animal Blood and $2oa Duskweed Petals for murloc bait, then return to Remy "Two Times" in Goldshire.

progress.text: Find everything?

accept.text:
Tell Mathers he can come pick up the bait later today. I'll give him the rundown on the proper usage.

Hopefully he'll be able to sell his fish again soon. And we'll have less murlocs in this world.

complete.text: Poisoned bait? As long as the fish aren't going to eat it, that should work. I'll visit Remy later to pick it up.

objectives.text: Return to Jason Mathers.

accept.text:
Those fish men must think like actual fish, right? Which means anything they like, fish will like!

If you rummage through some of their junk and return to me with anything that seems like it would make good bait, I'll reward you.

complete.text:
An interesting collection. These should work well enough!

Here's some of my own older supplies. It should help anyone trying to get their footing in fishing.

objectives.text: Collect $1oa pieces of shiny junk from the nearby Murloc camp.

progress.text: What did you find? Anything interesting?
